dct_title_s: Open Space Parcels - City of Newton
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer contains open space parcels in Newton, Massachusetts, that are portions of larger parcels where only part of the parcel is considered open space.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. This layer will provide a basemap for layers related to real property as well as more advanced user applications that may focus on urban planning and policy, public works, zoning or utilities purposes (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.)
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational, non-commercial use only.
Access constraints: Access is granted to licensee (Harvard University) only. Available only to Harvard University affiliates.
Data credit: GIS data supplied by City of Newton GIS.
